cli.help.sync:
Usage: {command} sync [--since <ref>] [--apply [--labels]] [--mark <page…> | --mark --all] [--sources <file[:lines]…>] [--date YYYY-MM-DD] [--check] [--estimate]

What the documentation must follow after a change of the application (ARCHITECTURE.md §6.10): without options, a report comparing the application now with sync.json (or with --since <ref>, a git commit); --mark records the pages checked now. Writes {work}/sync.md, {work}/sync-report.json and {work}/sync/<page>.diff. git is read only, through the application's app.dir.

Options
  --since <ref>            compares with this git commit instead of sync.json (no new/removed: the adapters are not re-run at that commit)
  --apply                  rewrites moved proofs (file:line) in the pages; restamps the pages left unchanged
  --labels                 with --apply: also replaces a label's old value by its new one, in the allowed contexts only
  --mark <page…>           records these pages as checked now
  --all                    with --mark: every written page
  --sources <file[:lines]…>  with --mark of a single page: declared sources, repeatable
  --date YYYY-MM-DD        date written by --mark instead of today's
  --check                  exit code 1 when any category but “unchanged” and “unmarked” is not empty
  --estimate               the cost of updating the pages to review (ARCHITECTURE.md §6.11)
cli.sync.noApp.help: set app.dir in doc.config.mjs, pointing at the application's code
cli.sync.noReference.help: run {command} sync --mark --all once the pages are checked
cli.sync.unwritten.help: write it first ({command} new {page} --template <type>), then mark it
cli.sync.sourcesOnePage: --sources only works with --mark naming exactly one page
cli.sync.proofUnresolved: [{page}] proof not recorded: {ref} (the file does not exist, or the line is beyond its end)
cli.sync.truncated: [{page}] the closure of local imports was cut at 200 files: some dependencies may be missing
cli.sync.noGit: no git here: a deleted file is never detected as a rename
cli.sync.sinceNoInventory: --since never reports new or removed elements: the coverage adapters are not re-run at that commit
cli.sync.title: Application: version {version}, commit {commit}, checked on {date}
cli.sync.proof.broken.textNotFound: [{page}] proof broken: {ref} (the cited text was not found again)
cli.sync.proof.broken.ambiguous: [{page}] proof broken: {ref} (the cited text was found more than once)
cli.sync.factsStale: facts behind the application's HEAD: {sources} — run {command} facts --source {sources}
cli.sync.check.failed: the documentation is behind the application
cli.sync.check.failed.help: read {work}/sync.md, fix what it lists, then run {command} sync --mark again

cli.sync.applied.summary.one: ✔ {proofs} proof and {labels} label fixed in {pages} page
cli.sync.applied.summary.other: ✔ {proofs} proofs and {labels} labels fixed in {pages} pages

cli.sync.md.title: Following the application
cli.audit.ind.upToDatePages: marked pages (`sync.json`) checked against the current version, among the written pages

cli.audit.action.upToDatePages.one: Check the page whose marked version is not {current}, then `{command} sync --mark` it
cli.audit.action.upToDatePages.other: Check the {n} pages whose marked version is not {current}, then `{command} sync --mark` them

cli.guided.situation.sync: {folder} — {product}'s documentation is behind the application's version.
cli.guided.menu.sync: what the documentation must follow since the last check
cli.sync.markNothing.help: run {command} sync --mark <page…>, or {command} sync --mark --all for every written page
